repo_meta_data.description: Mail for AI agents ( and humans). MCP server giving Claude (or any agent) safe, permission-controlled access to email (Microsoft Graph + IMAP), calendar and your knowledge files. Two-phase confirmation for sends, audit log, local index. No built-in LLM: your agent brings the intelligence.
